title: board.json
description: Metadata of a canonical board package (a ZIP with exactly `copper.gbr` and `board.json`). Made by `ingest`, read by `exposure` and `mill`. Lengths in millimetres, Y points up.

outline.description: Bounding box of the board outline center lines in the coordinates of `copper.gbr`.

contour.description: The real board shape from the outline layer (Edge.Cuts): the outer polygon and polygons of cutouts. Points in mm relative to the lower left corner of the outline box, the closing point is not repeated, arcs are approximated to 0.005 mm. Absent when the outline layer is not made of closed loops of lines and arcs: the board is then taken as its box.

x_mm.description: Distance from the left edge of the outline.

y_mm.description: Distance from the bottom edge of the outline.
